title: policy/budgets.yaml
description: Spend and turn limits (spec §3, §8.1). Provider-side caps are applied by hand or API; the run and turn caps are compiled into Hermes, Archon and hapi-guard; the repo and day caps are checked by the poller.

workspaces.description: Monthly spend limit in USD per Anthropic Console workspace.

openrouter_monthly_usd.description: Monthly cap on the OpenRouter key.

jev_monthly_usd.description: Monthly cap on Jev's own OpenRouter key.

repo_monthly_usd.description: The most one registered repo's runs may spend per UTC calendar month; the poller checks it before it starts a run. An overlay may lower it.

daily_usd.description: The most all registered repos' runs together may spend per UTC calendar day; the poller checks it before it starts a run. Central only.

enforcement.description: How each enforcer treats a spend limit: hard stops the run (the poller: refuses to start it), soft flags it and lets it finish. One setting per enforcement point.

hapi_guard.description: Pi's hapi-guard extension, which sums the run's spend per turn.

archon.description: Archon's budget on the factory-task workflow's children.

poller.description: The poller's checks before a run starts: repo_monthly_usd and daily_usd (the round counts in runs.yaml are always hard, whatever this says). hard refuses the run; soft starts it and flags it.
